label: Hypnosis reading — novels & erotica (Nov 2025 pass)
description: Adult-only published novels/novellas/short stories where a female character is hypnotized or mind-controlled. Lives in reads/entries.json (Reads catalog). This file is a staging mirror for review; not registered in scripts/sync.py LOCAL_SOURCES so it does not pollute the screen catalog.
note: Primary home is reads/entries.json. Rebuild with: python3 reads/build.py

records.title: The Beetle
records.creator: Richard Marsh
records.gist: A shape-shifting Egyptian entity uses mesmerism to control victims in London. Politician's daughter and secret fiancée Marjorie Lindon is hypnotized, abducted and dressed as a man for transport; she is later recovered unconscious and eventually marries Paul Lessingham.
records.where: Marjorie Lindon's narrative (capture); Champnell narrative (pursuit and recovery)
records.wife: no at hypnosis (secretly engaged); yes by the closing note (marries Lessingham)
records.note: Mesmerism/hypnosis of an adult fiancée; cult and shape-shifting frame the control.
records.adult_basis: adult political fiancée / daughter of an MP

records.title: The Lair of the White Worm
records.original_title: The Lair of the White Worm
records.creator: Bram Stoker
records.gist: Edgar Caswall, heir to Castra Regis and inheritor of Franz Mesmer's chest, repeatedly uses mesmerism against Lilla Watford (a little over twenty). Her cousin Mimi resists; Caswall's final mesmeric assault leaves Lilla drained and dead.
records.where: Repeated mesmeric assaults at Mercy Farm; fatal final visit

sources.label: Wikipedia: The Lair of the White Worm
The Gothic Library: The Horrors of Hypnotism

records.note: Same author as Dracula (already catalogued); this card is the mesmeric assaults on Lilla, not the White Worm subplot.
records.adult_basis: Lilla Watford described in the text as a little over twenty

records.title: Breaking the Girl
records.creator: Eva Marks
records.gist: Psychiatrist Dr. Marcus Kingston kidnaps Leighton (age 22), his daughter's adult best friend, and uses hypnosis among other coercive methods to dominate and recondition her in a dark romance frame.
records.pregnant_end: unknown (not confirmed from independent blurbs checked)
records.note: Gist and age (22) taken from publisher/author-facing listings and secondary catalog sites; clinical wording only.

records.title: Mesmer
records.creator: Cari Silverwood & Jennifer Bene
records.gist: Tomik, a 'mesmer' who can mentally control susceptible women called collectables, takes adult Hannah. He manipulates her memories, emotions and actions while holding her captive; they share a prior high-school history but the control occurs when both are adults.
records.where: Standalone dark romance in the Dark Hearts setting
records.note: Paranormal mind-control (mesmer ability), not stage hypnosis; adult-only at the time of control.
records.adult_basis: adult woman held as a 'collectable'; prior acquaintance was in high school

records.title: Hypnotically Taken
records.creator: Vicki Larson
records.gist: Recently divorced Jenna travels to Florida. Business consultant Andrew uses erotic hypnosis and mind control to reshape her desire and attachment so she bonds to him, alarming her friend Kerri.
records.note: Gist from publisher blurb; adults-only erotic hypnosis romance.

records.title: Giving Him Control
records.original_title: Giving Him Control (BBW Hypnosis Erotic Romance)
records.creator: Ariel Song
records.gist: A plus-sized adult woman enters therapy to improve her self-confidence. Her therapist uses hypnosis ostensibly to help her, then redirects the trances into a sexual dominance relationship.
records.note: Therapist–patient erotic hypnosis; clinical non-graphic summary only.

records.title: The Golden Artifact
records.original_title: The Golden Artifact: A Kinky Lesbian Mind Control Erotic Novella
records.creator: Jada Lynn
records.gist: Archaeologist Lindsay Kraven uses a mind-control artifact on her adult best friend Mandy, putting Mandy under her control as a pet and directing intimate acts; the power then turns in unexpected ways.

records.title: The Alpha Tomb
records.original_title: The Alpha Tomb: The Complete Series
records.creator: Neil Bimbeau
records.gist: Archaeologist Adam Roth's marriage is failing because his wife cannot give him an heir. After he gains hypnotic / mind-control power from a Pharaoh's tomb, women around him — including within the marriage — are compelled to serve him sexually as he builds a harem.
records.pregnant_end: intended / open (heir is the stated motive; blurbs do not confirm a birth)
records.kids_before: no (wife cannot provide an heir at the start)
records.note: Tomb-granted mind control used on adult women including his wife; pregnancy motive stated, birth not confirmed in blurbs.
records.adult_basis: married adult wife and other adult women

records.title: Tranced: His Unfaithful Wife
records.original_title: Tranced – His Unfaithful Wife (Hypno Revenge 3 of 3)
records.creator: Nadia Nightside
records.gist: Stage magician Warren finds a watch that hypnotically controls women. After his wife Melinda steals it for her own ends, he reclaims the watch and uses it to break her will, force fertility compliance and keep her as a controlled pet within a harem frame.
records.where: Hypno Revenge part 3 (also in the Tranced bundle)
records.pregnant_end: yes / intended (blurb states impregnation and an heir under control)
